assessment: Two parameterized cases invoke actual stream handler, actual database session context and actual LotTracker insertion, then inject failure only after both Execution and PositionLot are queried in the transaction.

Normal rollback and deliberately failed rollback both propagate explicit exceptions and produce stream ERROR log with matching cause; subsequent separate session verifies no persisted fill/lot or summary change.
Failed rollback case relies on actual session-close cleanup and explicitly verifies original lot exception remains the exception context.
Other three existing Wave51 tests are AST-identical. Replacing an obsolete comment marker with observed transaction/error behavior strengthens the relevant contract.
